objective: Count, at zero compute, how many of this lab's published results carry both a propagated uncertainty band and an external truth value that the band was not fitted to, and decide from that count whether a reliability curve over the lab's own predictions can be drawn at all
rationale: The standing directive is that every result ships with a band, and the machinery to produce one exists and has produced several. What has never been asked is whether those bands are calibrated. A band is a probabilistic claim, and a probabilistic claim that is never scored against outcomes is decoration. The lab already asks this question about its cost forecasts and publishes the answer even though the answer is bad, at zero of three within twenty percent; it has never asked it about its physical predictions, which are the ones customers would rely on. The evidence that it should is already on the record and points both ways. The flat plate propagation rung produced a coefficient band spanning 30.3 percent of the reference drag, roughly 104 times the validation discrepancy of that same case, and separately recorded that the Gaussian process error bars on that line were about three times too narrow, a finding that was recorded and then used nowhere. The standing model form batch produced a four closure spread of 62.4 percent on one plate case that does contain the reference value, and honestly refused a band on another family where every closure stalled. Those are individual containment facts. A reliability curve is what turns them into a calibration statement, and nobody knows whether enough pairs exist to draw one. This item is the census that decides, and it is deliberately filed as the census rather than as the curve, because filing the curve would be committing to a deliverable whose feasibility has not been measured
gate: A census, with its own admission rule declared before counting. A pair is ADMISSIBLE only if it carries (a) a published band with a stated nominal coverage and a stated channel composition, and (b) a truth value from OUTSIDE this lab -- a published experimental measurement, a benchmark distribution, an exact analytic result or an independent code's published result -- which was not used to centre, tune or calibrate that band. Every candidate is classified into ADMISSIBLE, EXCLUDED-NO-EXTERNAL-TRUTH, or EXCLUDED-TRUTH-USED-IN-CONSTRUCTION, and the excluded counts are PUBLISHED beside the admissible one; a census that reports only its survivors is the shape this lab has already been caught in. GO if 8 or more admissible pairs exist: the reliability curve is drawable and becomes its own proposal, priced against this census. NO-GO if fewer than 8: the curve cannot be drawn, and the deliverable becomes a named list of the cheapest cells that would make it drawable, priced. Either way the census itself is the product. IDENTITY TEST, per Verification Charter 2a. Q1, what makes this FAIL: too few admissible pairs. Q2, could a wrong treatment still pass? YES, and this is the central hazard of the whole direction, which is why it is gated at the census rather than discovered at the curve: if the truth value used to score containment is the same number the band was centred on or calibrated against, containment is an IDENTITY and every band contains its truth by construction. That is exactly the failure the charter's new clause names, and the EXCLUDED-TRUTH-USED-IN-CONSTRUCTION class exists to make it countable rather than invisible. A census that cannot determine which of the two a given pair is must class it as excluded and say so. EXTERNAL REFERENT, per Verification Charter 6a: one per admissible pair, by construction. A pair with no external referent is not admissible. That is the whole admission rule and it is why this direction cannot be run on our own machinery alone.
cost_basis: Zero solver compute. Every input is a published record already in the tree or a value already extracted from a published source; the work is enumeration, classification and reading. The basis for believing this is enumerable at all rather than open ended is that the external referent audit of 2026-08-11 derived its population mechanically over 1,549 verification sections across 297 tracked documents, so the corpus is a known size and a sweep of it is a bounded task with a stated frame. The one rate anchor for the SUCCESSOR, if the census returns GO and cells need filling, is the standing model form batch at 22.5 core minutes for 20 of 32 cells; that is not priced here and this item does not spend it
expected_knowledge_gain: A number the lab does not have and cannot guess: how many of its own physical predictions are scoreable against an outside answer. If the count clears the bar, the lab can draw a reliability curve over its own predictions, which is a thing essentially nobody in applied computational fluid dynamics ships and which would make the uncertainty layer a credential rather than a feature. If it does not clear the bar, the finding is that the band machinery has outrun the evidence that could validate it, and the correct next purchase is external truth values rather than more bands. The excluded counts carry the sharpest information of all: a large EXCLUDED-TRUTH-USED-IN-CONSTRUCTION class would mean this lab's containment successes are partly arithmetic, which is the identity failure the charter now forbids at gates and which has never been counted at the level of results
hard_criterion_note: Starts no flow case. It is a classification sweep over records already published, and it names the compute its successor would need rather than spending any
citations: The uncertainty propagation ladder record for the flat plate, for the coefficient band at 30.3 percent of reference drag against a validation discrepancy of 0.29 percent, and for the Gaussian process error bars recorded as about three times too narrow and used nowhere

The standing model form batch record, for the four closure spread of 62.4 percent containing the reference value on one plate case, and for the family whose band was honestly refused because every closure stalled
The calibration scorecard, for the precedent of publishing a bad self-assessment rather than a flattering one, and for the sixteen closed items that recorded no actual cost
The external referent audit of 2026-08-11, for the mechanically derived population of 1,549 verification sections across 297 tracked documents that bounds this sweep

The verification charter's identity clause, for the rule that a quantity derivable by construction from its own inputs may be reported and may never be gated, which is the admission rule this census enforces one level up
launch_prompt: Band containment census. ZERO COMPUTE. Step 1: write the admission rule down and commit it BEFORE enumerating anything, so the rule cannot be adjusted to the population. Step 2: derive the candidate population mechanically, not by memory or by listing what you remember -- state the frame, the filter and the commit, and use the sanctioned sweep helper rather than this shell's grep, which is ugrep --ignore-files and cannot see gitignored paths. Step 3: classify every candidate into the three classes and publish all three counts. For each ADMISSIBLE pair record the nominal coverage, the channels the band composes, the truth value, its published source, and the executed check that the truth was not used in constructing the band -- that last one is the whole point and 'it seems unlikely' is not an executed check. Step 4: apply the GO or NO-GO rule. On GO, file the reliability curve as its own proposal, priced from this census, and do NOT draw the curve inside this item. On NO-GO, deliver the priced list of cheapest cells that would make it drawable. Step 5: state your own blind spots -- which records you could not classify and why. A census reporting only its survivors is the defect this lab has already been caught in twice. Record: evidence file in demo-output/website/campaign/.
